visualCharacteristics.layout: Left media stage with thumbnails and expand dialog, right overview copy collapsed behind More plus document buttons
visualCharacteristics.notes: Two columns: left a media gallery (main chip image S32K3 HDQFP, expand button, "Click image to open expanded view", 4 thumbnails incl. 2 Brightcove videos); right overview text (3 paragraphs with inline links, truncated with "More" toggle) followed by "Data Sheet" and "Reference Manual" outline buttons and an ECAD (PCB symbol / 3D model) icon link.

contentPattern.structure: 1 row x 2 cells: images and video links | overview paragraphs, buttons, icon link

reuseGuidance: Use when a media gallery sits beside descriptive text; use columns for static image/text.
